rebuttal.rebuttal: The indexing explanations and list of alternatives establish that the video teaches something; they do not settle what the teaching is used to sell. Calling those elements ordinary promotion overlooks how the lesson can create demand for the advertised help.

opening.argument: The video presents itself as an update and a practical SEO lesson, yet the provider's description advertises both business-planning help and job-oriented courses. The speaker also directs viewers to another video before returning to the main topic and closes by asking them to subscribe. Those choices make the lesson an audience-building channel for the provider's commercial offers. Judge the business-growth pitch in that promotional context, rather than treating the presence of diagrams and alternatives as proof that the video has no solicitation.
